title: Volkswagen 2008-2014 TSI (GTI, Jetta, Passat, CC, Eos, Tiguan, Beetle): timing chain / tensioner failure, class settlement warranty extension (VWP-18-07)
summary: Under a class settlement, Volkswagen extended coverage on the timing chain and tensioner of certain 2008-2014 models to 10 years / 100,000 miles from the in-service date. The chain and tensioner themselves are covered 100%. Engine damage directly caused by a chain or tensioner failure is covered on a sliding scale, 25% to 100% depending on age and mileage. Owners must show reasonable oil-change records, within 10% of the schedule.

warnings: Volkswagen requires proof of oil changes within 10% of the scheduled time and mileage. If records can't be found, a signed sworn declaration under penalty of perjury may substitute.

specs.name: Timing chain / tensioner coverage
specs.value: 10 years or 100,000 miles from the original in-service date, 100% of the chain and tensioner repair
specs.note: From the in-service date, so 2008-2014 vehicles have now aged out.

specs.name: Engine damage coverage, 5 years or less
Credit when a replacement engine already has a new chain/tensioner
specs.value: Owner's share reduced by up to $2,000

specs.name: Minimum documented oil services (10% variance), by miles since you took ownership
Covered vehicles (certain VINs)
specs.value: 2012-2014 Beetle and Beetle Convertible; 2009-2012 CC; 2009-2012 Eos; 2008-2012 GTI; 2008-2010 and 2012-2014 Jetta Sedan; 2009 Jetta SportWagen; 2008-2010 Passat Sedan and Wagon; 2009-2013 Tiguan

steps.text: Dealer checks the VIN in ElsaPro > Vehicle Data. Eligible vehicles show the extension under Enhanced Coverage.
Bring oil-change records for your time of ownership (invoices, receipts), or a signed sworn declaration if records can't be obtained.

A failed chain or tensioner is repaired at 100%. Any engine damage it directly caused is prorated by the age and mileage table; Volkswagen gives dealers a proration estimating tool to quote your share.

body: Volkswagen says the extension is fully transferable to later owners. Damage from abuse, modification, collision or vandalism is excluded, and the repair must be done at a Volkswagen dealer.
